name: mode-keyword
description: Retrieval-mode arm, mode=keyword. Identical to baseline except retrieval.mode. Full-text search only — no vector arm, so the query embedding is never used and RRF fuses a single list, making the ordering pure lexical rank. Exists to disambiguate the dense-vs-hybrid tie: hybrid reorders 77/77 result sets and moves no metric, which is equally consistent with fusing two comparable signals and with fusing a strong vector ranking into a weak lexical one. DEVIATION: docs/EVAL_HARNESS.md defines dense|hybrid only; see eval/src/types.ts RetrievalMode. Run with --retrieval-only.
